After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] captured the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chabosh]] by overthrowing its [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Chabosh)|Imperial governor]] they established a '''planetary stronghold''' that was defended by [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harsh]] to [[Battle of Chabosh (Galactic Civil War)|retake the planet]], he personally led a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the final assault on the stronghold and successfully captured it, although he received serious injuries in the process.<ref name="US" />
